description.value: Tre Viet is an authentic Northern Vietnamese restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the English Bay seawall and its popular cycling routes. The restaurant takes its name from the Vietnamese word for bamboo, a cultural symbol of resilience, and offers a full menu of traditional dishes including pho, bánh mì, salad rolls, and rice dishes with both indoor and outdoor seating. Its location in a high-traffic tourist and cycling corridor near English Bay makes it a natural stop for riders exploring the seawall.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 74m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m; stands (4 spaces) at 86m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms name, address (1114 Denman St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1T2), phone (604 423 5555), and hours. The menu explicitly lists multiple vegetarian and tofu-based dishes (Vegetarian Tofu Baguette, Tofu Salad Roll, Mini Spring Rolls Chay, Deep Fried Young Rice Cake Chay), supporting a value=true for Vegetarian/vegan/GF. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, wi-fi, or takeout is made anywhere on the website or in OSM tags beyond what is standard for a sit-down restaurant.
concerns: Email address discrepancy on website: the reservations page body text reads 'trevietlcfood@gmail.ca' while the footer contact block on all pages reads 'trevietlcfood@gmail.com'. The .com version is likely correct; the .ca may be a typo.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating in a prime cycling corridor near the English Bay seawall; a genuine food stop for touring cyclists, with confirmed vegetarian options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes dedicated vegetarian items: Vegetarian Tofu Baguette (Bánh Mì Chay), Tofu Salad Roll (Gỏi Cuốn Chay), Mini Spring Rolls Chay, and Deep Fried Young Rice Cake Chay
